posts.title: two hundred inches
posts.description: We just crossed 200 inches of rainfall for the year, according to my local weather station. One year ago I was complaining that we were still in a drought, though I didn’t actually record the year-to-date rainfall then. 2025 was one of the driest years on record for our region, and I’m pretty sure this year will go down as one of the wettest. I’m not sure if that climate instability can be racked

posts.title: Radioactive Man
posts.description: Unsplash It’s done. I am now a walking source of 131 I, radioactive iodine. The radioisotope is an emitter of beta and gamma particles; the former are destructive to tissue (like remnants of my thyroid gland) so you normal folks should stay away from it. I’m emitting small amounts of radiation, though few beta particles will make it out of my body and those won’t travel more than a maximum of 165
